A fishing charter in Virginia Beach and the Chesapeake Bay area offers the perfect way to connect with nature, learn a new skill, and create lasting memories - all while exploring the beautiful waters that this region is known for. At Captain Hogg’s Charters, we specialize in family-friendly fishing adventures aboard our spacious and comfortable boat, the Smokin’ Gun II. Fishing is an incredible activity for all ages.
